statement: Dolphin's emulated MotionPlus reads exactly 16 bytes of the attached downstream accessory calibration from its normal register offset 0x20 and caches those same bytes in its own active register 0x40-0x4f; the reviewed copy does not reformat them. ControllerInterface asks A40040/16 for Nunchuk/Classic calibration if MotionPlus is active, and otherwise A40020/16 when normal extension is active. It checks the standard two-byte extension checksum but records calibration with a bad-checksum flag rather than automatically abandoning a successful read. The WiiBrew MotionPlus page covers calibration at the MotionPlus's 0x20 region but does not independently document A40040 forwarding, so retail copy behavior remains unverified.
